title: Chapter 181 Six Major Forces
content:
Chapter 181 Six Major Forces

"Brother Drunk, what do you want?"

"Yes, I want to go out and make my own way."

The drunk old man slapped the table and stood up.

Looking at the determination in the eyes of the drunk old man, everyone sighed inwardly.

In the end, the drunk old man left.

He resolutely embarked on his own path.

"Brother Drunk, he is better than us."

The two looked at the back of the drunk old man and were filled with emotion.

As the deserted city went farther and farther, the few people who had gathered together also had some differences.

Now, the old man Broken Sword left, and the drunk old man also left.

Ye Hanshuang fell into the mall and never came back.

Only Nangong Fang and Shi Tianzhi were left.

The two looked at each other, finally sighed, and then left.

It can only be said that everyone's path is different.

At the same time.

The core members of the deserted city also began their own preparations.

At the call of Lu Daosheng, everyone came to the main hall of the city lord's mansion.

"Lord City Lord."

Seeing Lu Daosheng sitting on top, everyone immediately bowed respectfully.

"Do you know why I called you here?"

Lu Daosheng looked at everyone and smiled slightly.

Hearing this, everyone immediately looked at each other.

Finally, Gu Chen stood up.

"Lord City Lord, we are going to a higher level world, so Lord City Lord should be worried that our strength will not be enough."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng nodded.

"Gu Chen is right. Although I have already made arrangements in the fairy world, your strength is still too weak there."

After Lu Daosheng finished speaking, he spread his right hand.

An illusory space tunnel appeared in front of everyone.

"This is a world I have created with my heart and soul. There are countless opportunities and treasures in it. I will give you three thousand years. As I said, how much you can improve depends on you."

Hearing this, everyone was immediately excited.

Especially An Xing and Gu Chen, they are very familiar with this.

The city lord is going to give them special treatment again.

So cool!

Qin Yi, Jiang Bei and others were shocked.

At the same time, there was a little doubt in their eyes.

Three thousand years?

They thought they would go to the upper realm after a while.

Unexpectedly, there are still three thousand years.

However, since there is so much time, they don’t have to rush.

"We, thank you, city lord."

Then, under the leadership of A Wei and others, everyone entered the world created by Lu Daosheng one by one.

As a bright light flashed before their eyes.

The surrounding scene changed drastically in an instant.

Jiang Bei slowly opened his eyes and found that his colleagues around him had disappeared, and there was a dark world in front of him.

At this time, a piercing scream sounded.

Jiang Bei frowned slightly, then turned around and punched out.

Boom!

I saw a strange creature being blown into pieces.

Buzz——

"Hmm?"

Jiang Bei was slightly stunned. A stream of pure energy slowly emerged from the body of the strange creature and flowed directly into his body.

Suddenly, Jiang Bei's breath became a little stronger.

Although it was only a little, it still surprised Jiang Bei a little.

At this time, there was a movement behind him, and dense strange creatures rushed towards here.

Seeing this scene, Jiang Bei smiled.

At the same time, similar scenes were also staged in other places.

In the City Lord's Mansion.

Lu Daosheng looked at everyone who had started their own practice, and then nodded with satisfaction.

At this time, several figures came from outside the hall.

The leader was Jian Xin and others.

"Meet the City Lord."

Seeing Lu Daosheng, Jian Xin and others immediately said respectfully.

Lu Daosheng nodded, and then said: "You were all Lingyun's subordinates before, but now, you have all joined the Wasteland City, and you are also my subordinates, so I will not be partial."

Buzz——

Suddenly, a space tunnel appeared in front of everyone again.

Lu Daosheng briefly described this world for them, and then said: "You can choose whether to enter or not."

Hearing this, everyone looked at each other, with shock in their eyes.

One day in the outside world is a hundred years in the inner world.

What kind of heaven-defying method is this? It is simply unheard of.

Let alone what opportunities there are in it, even if you just practice in it for a period of time, it is a great opportunity.

Thinking of this, everyone no longer hesitated.

"We, thank you, Lord City Lord."

Then, led by Jian Xin and others, everyone rushed into the space-time tunnel.

After a while, the hall returned to calm again.

Standing in the empty hall, Lu Daosheng slowly closed his eyes, and his consciousness instantly covered the entire Wasteland City.

The entire deserted city was made by Lu Daosheng himself.

It is also a great weapon of ancient gold.

If Lu Daosheng uses the deserted city to fight the enemy, even if the immortals from heaven come, Lu Daosheng can suppress them directly.

At this moment, Lu Daosheng is hesitating whether to take this deserted city to the fairyland.

After a moment of silence, Lu Daosheng finally gave up the idea.

When he reaches the fairyland, at most he can just build another one.

With his own foundation, it will only take some time.

Looking up at the sky, Lu Daosheng stood up and headed towards the direction of the Ten Thousand Spirits Realm.

.........

At this time, the Wood Immortal Realm.

"Senior Wanfeng, do we really have to be so high-profile?"

A figure with a strong aura hesitated.

Hearing this, Wanfeng nodded, "Of course, my master said that there is no need to be afraid of things. If something happens, he and Master are there."

This is what Lu Daosheng said to her before he left.

Hearing this, the man in front of Wanfeng wiped the cold sweat from his forehead.

"But, there is no need to declare war directly on the six top immortal forces in the Wood Immortal Realm."

That is the force standing at the top of the Wood Immortal Realm.

One sect, two sects and three holy places.

A long time ago, the Immortal Spirit Holy Land was strangely destroyed, and then another holy land rose and replaced the position of the Immortal Spirit Holy Land.

Now, with the passage of time, the strength of the six major forces has not only not weakened, but has become stronger and stronger.

In the Wood Immortal Realm, they do not allow any force to dare to touch their interests.

However, Wanfeng founded the Deserted City and came out of nowhere.

The power developed very quickly and soon attracted the attention of the six major forces.

Facing the deserted city, the six major forces erupted with unprecedented hostility and wanted to strangle the deserted city in the cradle.

Everyone would think that the deserted city would give in and eventually disband.

But unexpectedly, Wanfeng would be so stubborn and directly declare war on the six major forces.

At this time, Wanfeng walked up to the man and patted his shoulder.

"Don't worry, I have never taken these forces seriously. If they have heard of my name, they may not do this."

Wanfeng's words puzzled the man.

But he didn't think much about it.

After all, he was just a worker, and he came to the deserted city to work for Wanfeng because of the good treatment, that's all.

Once things go wrong, he will be the first to run away.

After the man left, Wanfeng stood on the deserted city he built and looked at the direction of the sky.

"Six major forces? Haha, you really take yourself seriously."

These six major forces are known as the six strongest forces in the Wood Immortal Realm by the world, but that is only on the surface after all. Only the truly strong know that in the dark, there is an even more terrifying old sixth force in the Wood Immortal Realm.
